summary: Thiscall constructor that initializes a surface/bitmap container: allocates a zeroed pixel-buffer of a2 bytes into this+0x0 (size recorded at this+0x4), allocates and zero-initializes an array of a4 clip-rectangle entries (each a pair of WORDs) into this+0x8 (count a4 at this+0xC), clears counters at this+0x10 and this+0x14, and stores dimensions a3 and a5 at this+0x18 and this+0x1C, defaulting each to 1 when the argument is zero. Returns this. When the clip-rectangle allocation fails, this+0x8 is set to null and the remaining fields are still initialized.

local_names.v6: pixel buffer allocation for size a2
local_names.v7: clip-rectangle entry array allocation of a4 entries, each 4 bytes
local_names.a3: surface width, defaulted to 1 when zero
local_names.a5: surface height, defaulted to 1 when zero

operations.description: Allocate the pixel buffer of a2 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper
Store the pixel buffer pointer at this+0x0 and its size a2 at this+0x4, then zero the buffer for a2 bytes
Allocate the clip-rectangle entry array of 4 * a4 bytes via OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper
When the clip-rectangle allocation succeeded, zero-initialize a4 entries, each entry a pair of WORDs (index 0 and index 1 of a 2-WORD unit), walking the array 4 bytes at a time
Store the clip-rectangle array pointer at this+0x8, or null at this+0x8 when the allocation failed
Store the clip-rectangle entry count a4 at this+0xC
Initialize the working indices this+0x10 and this+0x14 to 0
Store a3 at this+0x18 as the width, defaulting the stored value to 1 when a3 is zero
Store a5 at this+0x1C as the height, defaulting the stored value to 1 when a5 is zero
Return the constructed surface container pointer (this)
Invoked by SEHProtectedDirectXRenderStateSetup as part of DirectX render-state surface setup
